claims.text: On 9 March , Golasgil led a long line of men of many sorts to Minas Tirith before the Battle of Pelennor Fields. With the exception of the men of his household the men that he commanded - hunters, herdsmen, and villagers - were scantily equipped. Since Golasgil was not mentioned among the fallen in the Song of the Mounds of Mundburg, it appears that he survived the Battle of the Pelennor Fields.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix B, "The Great Years", entry for the year 3019, March 9, p. 1093
